ui.description: Add the A-share stocks you want to follow. The app will organize company facts, prices, dividends, and financial snapshots in the background before it prepares a reference for each stock.
ui.calloutDescription: You can add holdings later, and background stock syncing will not block you from entering the app.
ui.cardDescription: Tell the app which stocks you want to follow first. Holdings, cost basis, and cash can be added later.
ui.stockSectionDescription: Add more than one stock; each one will be organized separately.
ui.holdingSectionDescription: This helps the reference separate your core position from the shares you can adjust.
ui.submitHint: Your portfolio is created first. Stock names, prices, and dividend data sync in the background, so you can enter the app without waiting.
ui.footnote: Stock codes must contain 6 digits. The exchange distinguishes securities that share a code. This page never receives or stores a data-provider key.
ui.validationMessage: Enter a portfolio name and a 6-digit A-share code for every stock.
ui.requestError: Setup failed. Check the stock code and exchange, then try again.

setup_validation_failed.title: The setup request is invalid
setup_validation_failed.validation_message: Please review the setup request fields and try again.

setup_already_completed.title: Setup already completed
setup_already_completed.detail: The system has completed initial setup and cannot be initialized again.

setup_not_completed.title: Setup has not been completed
setup_not_completed.detail: Complete initial setup before configuring stock model parameters.
